youtube.description:
Start the day with Robo and Pip! The alarm clock rings, Pip wakes up and the morning routine begins: wash your face, brush your teeth, put on your clothes and eat your breakfast, all to the tune of Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush. Do each action with Robo, guess what comes next, light up a star for every step, and put the four pictures in order at the end.

The routine, in order: wake up, wash, brush, dress, eat.

Sing at home: sing a verse while you do each step in the morning, do the actions together, and ask "What comes next?" before each one. The verses are original (Toy Box Friends), sung to the traditional public-domain tune of Here We Go Round the Mulberry Bush.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.
